```text
- Deployment process ▸ Preparation phase a. collect approved changes • build artifact ↪ requires coordination across teams ▸ Configuration stage ↪ set credentials and permissions ▸ Validation checks i. run automated tests ii. verify staging environment ↪ catch issues early before production ▸ Cutover execution i. stop old service ii. start new version iii. monitor health checks ▸ Post-deployment activities a. document changes b. alert stakeholders ↪ keep users informed
- Risk management ▸ Timeline requirements ↪ cycle takes four hours of setup work ▸ Network verification a. verify network configuration b. prepare rollback procedures ↪ handle unexpected issues in deployment ▸ Analysis phase ↪ capture performance metrics and usage data
```
